rationale: The agent found that plate/run date is confounded with status (51/63 cases on plates 1-2 vs 12/70 controls, roughly 85% vs 15%). It measured a plate-only AUROC of 0.78, close to the key's ~0.82, and declined to report the 0.82 as a real signature. It proposed re-randomizing samples across plates and using plate-aware/leave-one-plate-out CV, which matches the key's fix.
